title: Free comics and magazines
blurb: The comics that fell out of copyright or were never renewed, plus the web platforms that publish for free and pay by advertising.

items.d: Golden-age comics, scanned and cleared for download by their uploaders.
A volunteer index of comic books by issue, with credits and story lists rather than scans.
Scans of single issues and collected runs, some lendable, some open.
Vertical-scroll comics, free to read with a wait for the newest episodes.
Webcomics and serialised novels, with an ink currency for the impatient.
Independent publishers and self-published series, free chapters beside paid ones.
